behavior.release: Capture COM+28, current-table AddRef then captured-object current-table Release; reload current COM+28 for final current-table Release; clear+28 only after return; no retries/cleanup if a call throws.
behavior.unlock: Capture current COM+28; null leaves current depth intact; current COM table stdcall+30 then wrapped --current_depth+20 even failed HRESULT; throwing COM prevents decrement.
behavior.storage: Actual borrowed2Ch owner; no semantic D3D9BufferBinding, owner construction/destruction or pool work.

focused_fixture.original_code: Installed PE span bytes copied unchanged into separate RX page; all branches local and calls indirect; no code bridges or relocations.
focused_fixture.runtime_postimage_checks: All six library bodies and all six native copies compared to pinned original bytes after all14 paired cases.
focused_fixture.comparison: Same actual owner/COM storage addresses reused; complete raw DWORD/state frames compared literally, without pointer-role normalization. ABI stack delta normalized to0, not an owner/COM field.
focused_fixture.COM_endpoints: Deterministic actual x86 stdcall vtable endpoints in ignored fixture only; production performs direct current COM forwarding.
